All opinions expressed by podcast participants. are solely their own opinion and do not reflect the opinion of newfound research. My guest this episode is Clayton Gillespie, VP at Deutsche Bank, where he works in quant equity research for the QIS team.

positions.commentary: The speaker considers Tesla a medium to high quality growth stock with good momentum and high beta.

thesis: This episode presents a fundamental view of quant equity, specifically identifying Tesla as a medium to high quality growth stock characterized by good momentum and high beta.
